question: Approve DEV-52 to enter POC implementation: one reverse-recovery inventory over kc-dev-flow surfaces, stop below five removal candidates, no edits?

artifacts.summary: Recommend approval: Linear DEV-52 bound (Todo, Cycle 2, Project kc-dev-flow slimming dogfood, sprint S8).
